sloka: सूत मद्वचनात् तस्य तातस्य विदित आत्मनः ।शिरसा वन्दनीयस्य वन्द्यौ पादौ महात्मनः ॥२-५८-१५॥
transliteration: sūta madvacanāt tasya tātasya vidita ātmanaḥ ।śirasā vandanīyasya vandyau pādau mahātmanaḥ ॥2-58-15॥

translations.english: 'Convey on my behalf, O charioteer to my illustrious father who is known for his selfknowledge, and is worthy of homage, that I am saluting his feet with my head bowed.
translations.hindi: इस पव त पर महात्मा और मुनि लोग भी निवात करते हैं । अतएब यही हमारे रहने योग्य है और हम यहीं रहेगे
